description: This is an abstract base class for various spreadsheet file readers in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides common functionality such as configuration options, security handling, and file loading mechanisms for subclasses that implement specific formats.

classes.name: BaseReader
classes.description: An abstract class providing foundational functionalities for reading spreadsheet files, handling various configuration options, file access, and security features.

methods.name: getReadDataOnly
methods.description: Returns whether only data values are to be read, ignoring formatting.

methods.name: setReadDataOnly
methods.description: Sets whether to read only data values.

methods.name: getReadEmptyCells
methods.description: Returns whether empty cells are read.

methods.name: setReadEmptyCells
methods.description: Sets whether to read empty cells.

methods.name: getIncludeCharts
methods.description: Returns whether charts should be included when reading.

methods.name: getLoadSheetsOnly
methods.description: Returns the list of specific sheets to load, or null for all sheets.

methods.name: setLoadAllSheets
methods.description: Configures the reader to load all sheets.

methods.name: getReadFilter
methods.description: Returns the currently set read filter.

methods.name: setReadFilter
methods.description: Sets the read filter to be used.

methods.name: getSecurityScanner
methods.description: Returns the security scanner object if set.

methods.name: getSecurityScannerOrThrow
methods.description: Returns the security scanner or throws an exception if null.

methods.name: processFlags
methods.description: Processes bitmask flags to set reading options.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromFile
methods.description: Abstract method to load a spreadsheet from a file; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a spreadsheet from a file with optional flags.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Opens the specified file for reading.

methods.name: setAllowExternalImages
methods.description: Configures whether external images are allowed.

methods.name: getAllowExternalImages
methods.description: Returns whether external images are allowed.
